learning_outcomes.text: Deepen theoretical and practical knowledge in their chosen field of study.
Foster intercultural competences and global thinking.
Learn to collaborate with lecturers and students of other nationalities and cultural backgrounds.
Prove oneself in a foreign educational structure.

syllabus_topics: Students shall take courses in their chosen field of study in selected subjects and complete them with examinations.

assessment_methods.method: Proof of examinations passed during the study abroad period, amounting to at least 5 ECTS

assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the required academic achievements. The grade's relevance for the final grade is determined according to the study and examination regulations (SPO).
